source_review: Eight supplied source images visually inspected; raw pixels and private paths excluded.
distribution: Source and generated output pixels are local-only, not distributed. Local artifact labels and hashes document local visual review, not publicly resolvable output files.
test_method: Four text-only branch/format tests, one new body-aware text-only portrait, one source-attached edit of a previously generated fictional adult. Primary and independent visual review completed.

cases.visual_review: Airy blue-white field, warm readable face, styled braid, layered cloth and companion-facing turn transferred.
cases.limitations: Body volume was under-specified and did not meet user preference; see body follow-ups. Map is not blank-backed.

cases.visual_review: Blue-white summer treatment transferred to inhabited fantasy architecture; observer gaze and pointing link to floating island.
cases.limitations: People occupy more foreground area than requested; not literal small-figure architecture framing. Camera reads closer to eye-level balcony than requested high-oblique view.

cases.visual_review: Warm hair/water light, cooler environment, held case and companion hand interaction transfer to a different adult subject.
cases.limitations: Skin becomes quite amber; hand pose is foreshortened and case silhouette only partially visible.

cases.visual_review: Vertical depth, canopy softness, lake blue, adult curator and reaching page create a new scene.
cases.limitations: Book contains generated pseudo-text despite no-text constraint; age reads approximate and body shape was not the preference target.

cases.visual_review: Natural bust-to-waist and hip contour, supported dress, mild neckline and summer styling are visible; original adult character and ordinary fashion coverage.
cases.limitations: Body proportions are a visual approximation; this is not source identity/body reconstruction or a guarantee for future calls.

cases.visual_review: Bust and torso volume became more readable while the same face, pose, map and summer setting broadly persisted.
cases.limitations: Neckline is visibly lowered and coverage changes despite explicit preservation; small jewelry also changes. Hips are partly hidden. Torso change succeeded but preserve contract did not fully pass.

scope: No model fine-tuning, exact source identity recreation, video validation, A/B baseline or reliable acceptance-rate claim.

independent_review.finding: Cross-subject style and aspect-ratio adaptation are supported. New body-aware portrait meets ordinary adult fashion intent. Source-attached body edit changes neckline/coverage and is only a partial preserve result.
